# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }} OntoPortal is an open-source software stack for building ontology and semantic artefact repositories (catalogues), maintained by the OntoPortal Alliance. The documentation has three guides: the User Guide (browse, search and use portals), the Administration Guide (install, configure and maintain an OntoPortal appliance) and the Developer Guide (APIs, widgets, contributing).

Notes for agents:
- Base URL: {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/ . Every link below is a rendered HTML page.
- Administration Guide pages exist in two appliance versions: {{ site.opva }} 3.2 (default) and 4.1. The 4.1 variants are listed under "Optional" and their URL ends with `/v41`.
- Source code: <https://github.com/ontoportal>. Alliance website: <https://ontoportal.org>.
